title: Béchamel Sauce (White Sauce)
description: One of the five classic French mother sauces, made with a white roux and milk to create a smooth, creamy base for gratins, lasagna, pasta dishes, and numerous derived sauces.

instruction.title: Instruction
steps: Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat.
Add the flour and whisk continuously for 2–3 minutes to form a smooth white roux without allowing it to brown.
Gradually whisk in the hot milk, adding a little at a time to prevent lumps.
Add the bay leaf and clove-studded onion if using.
Simmer gently for 10–15 minutes, whisking occasionally until the sauce becomes smooth and thick.
Remove the bay leaf and onion.
Season with salt, white pepper, and a pinch of nutmeg.
For an ultra-smooth finish, strain through a fine sieve or chinois before serving.

chefTips: Always use hot milk with a warm roux for a lump-free sauce.
Cook the roux gently without browning to maintain the classic white color.
Whisk continuously while adding milk for a silky texture.
Béchamel is the base for Mornay, Soubise, and Crème sauces.
Ideal for lasagna, gratins, macaroni and cheese, and Croque Monsieur.
